scope: User-approved best-effort tracking; campaign flow takes priority over mark completeness. Local only.
changes: Cached configuration only on send/ACK paths; refresh in background.
RAM source staging with asynchronous ordered journal, no producer waiters; owner admission without disk wait and generation-fenced RPC completion.
Background listener preparation with per-instance deduplication and 60-second failure cooldown.
Chat ACK uses recipient try-lock and skips optional metadata under contention.

checks.nonblockingFaultInjection: PASS: stalled config/restore/write, rejected disk, detail/counter completion, Server admission, late completion without resend, listener timeout/cooldown
checks.privatePostgresConcurrency: PASS: real ACK completes while competing tracking lock is held; subsequent event resumes tracking; retained metadata and config promotion in both commit orders

limits: No production changes, deployment, real Zalo traffic or application connection-budget increase. Tracking may miss events under failure, contention or cold configuration. Existing benchmark results are historical; no new load claim.
